verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a Git hosting service, but nothing in the evidence pack documents access tokens scoped to specific repositories, per-token permissions, or token expiry dates. The pack mentions only general user permission management, access control lists, and that the API guide covers authentication. These are adjacent controls, not the fine-grained token capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create fine-grained access tokens limited to specific repositories, permissions, and an expiry date
